# Ragdoll Drop Online

> Play Ragdoll Drop online for free in the browser: a physics arcade game in
> which you launch a floppy ragdoll down fifteen trap-filled levels, score from
> the impacts it takes on the way and spend the coins on vehicles, props and
> upgrades. No download, no account, no install.

Ragdoll Drop is developed by Ericetto and listed on Poki. This site is an
unofficial fan page that embeds a public CDN copy of the Unity WebGL build and
publishes written guides. It does not host or modify the game files.

## Play

- [Play Ragdoll Drop](https://ragdoll-drop.github.io/) — the game loads in the
  page. Hold the round button to charge the launch, release to drop, tap the
  same button mid-run to jump.

## Guides

- [How to Play](https://ragdoll-drop.github.io/how-to-play/) — the objective, how
  the launch and scoring work, what the shop sells and the mistakes that end a run.
- [Controls](https://ragdoll-drop.github.io/controls/) — the launch and jump
  button, the HUD, the shop column, plus a translation of the on-screen labels.
- [Tips & Tricks](https://ragdoll-drop.github.io/tips/) — reading a level,
  building chain reactions, choosing a vehicle and earning coins faster.
- [Unblocked](https://ragdoll-drop.github.io/unblocked/) — running the game on
  school or work networks, and fixing a player that stays black.

- [About](https://ragdoll-drop.github.io/about/)

## Facts

- Game: Ragdoll Drop, free, browser-based, Unity WebGL, around 10+.
- Studio: Ericetto. Official listing: Poki.
- Genres: physics arcade, action, simulation.
- Levels: fifteen, plus vehicle, prop and ragdoll upgrades bought with coins.
- Controls: hold to launch, release to drop, tap to jump — mouse or touch.
- Interface language: the publicly embeddable build ships with Russian menus.
- Cost: free, no account. Progress is stored in the browser.
